QuestInfo.name: A Quiet Line of Work
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p900014# at #m10003010# has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: #p900014# at #m10003010#, unlike his brother #p502#, a renowned swordsman, had secretly been doing exorcism work, hunting down evil spirits. He said he could sense the power of a strong evil spirit somewhere around #m10003000#, and suggested that while he investigated elsewhere, I go investigate deep within the subway. If I ran into any #b#o43#s#k down there, it sounded like I'd need to defeat them all. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I defeated #o43# deep within the #m10003000# subway and went back to #p900014#. Still, there was something serious about the look on his face...

0.0: You again. Seems you know my brother too, huh? I keep hearing adventurers mention #p502#'s name, so I guess he's become a fairly well-known swordsman. Whatever, doesn't matter to me either way. We haven't had much to do with each other's lives in a long time now.
0.1: Wait, actually, I've got something to say to you today. ... Aren't you curious what I've been doing? ... ... The truth is, I've been quietly doing exorcism work around here. That's right — hunting down evil spirits that died holding onto some grudge. As you probably know, that kind of thing happens often enough in this city.
0.2: But lately, I've been sensing an unusually powerful evil presence all over #m10003000#. Evil spirits show up from time to time, sure, but I've never felt this many going wild at once — it's more than I can handle alone. So, here's what I'm proposing.

yes.0: Listen up, then. Ever been deep into the #m10003000# subway? I've been sensing the spirits down there acting up lately. So get down there and take out every #b#o43##k you come across. Meanwhile, I'll go investigate the rest of #m10003000#.

no.0: You're no fun. Just remember, if word gets out that I'm an exorcist, you'll be the first one I take out.

1.0: That took longer than I expected. But I'll admit, you've got some skill. Not that you're anywhere close to me, of course.

mob.0: There's a powerful evil presence coming from deep within the #b#m10003000##k subway. Get down there and wipe out the #b#o43#s#k.
